subject: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie@finexco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Hi Sophie,

Great to meet earlier - thanks for your time and for walking us through Finexco's fraud-alerting use case. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Hosted API is a good fit for your 1-5 TPS bursty traffic pattern and for rapid iteration during model selection.
- For production with predictable throughput and isolated capacity we discussed Dedicated; for strict data residency (on-prem) we can discuss Private VPC.

Immediate next steps (we can support these from Hosted today):
1) Quickstart: I attached a one-page quickstart (redwood-quickstart.pdf) with Postman/cURL examples to get you generating within minutes.
2) Endpoints: You can use our standard /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints. I included recommended param presets for short-form classification vs long-form generation.
3) Rate limits: Your account will start on the hosted tier with default soft limits. Typical default: 60 req/min and 600 tokens/sec aggregate. We can request a higher burst for the eval - see attached hosted-api-rate-limits.csv for tiered examples.

Questions for you to help us qualify:
- Do you need guaranteed SLAs or strict tenancy for the eval period?
- Any regulatory/data-residency constraints that would push you toward Private?
- Who from engineering should we copy for API keys/access?

If you want, we can spin up an evaluation API key scoped to Finexco and pre-warm a small concurrency capacity so you can run the smoke tests Matt mentioned.

I'll follow up with Marissa (CS) to coordinate onboarding and any telemetry you want captured.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood-quickstart.pdf (1 page, PDF)
Attachment: hosted-api-rate-limits.csv (CSV)

From: Sophie Lee <sophie@finexco.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finexco Procurement <procurement@finexco.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Thanks, Aditya - useful summary. A few clarifications: 

- For the initial eval (2 weeks) we don't need an SLA, but we do need to ensure PII never leaves our environment for certain request types. How does Hosted handle sensitive fields?
- Rate limits: our typical test traffic will peak ~3 TPS with short payloads (<256 tokens). If the default is 60 req/min that might be limiting for parallel tests - can you confirm burst behavior and whether we can get a higher limit for the eval?
- Engineering point of contact is Matt Gomez (matt.gomez@finexco.com). Can you include him on the onboarding?

Also procurement asked for an estimated cost range for a 2-week eval with ~10k tokens/day.

Thanks,
Sophie
Head of Fraud Ops - Finexco

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie@finexco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Matt Gomez <matt.gomez@finexco.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Hi Sophie - looping Matt in. Answers below and a proposed plan: 

1) PII/sensitive fields: Hosted API supports request-level redaction and you can opt to disable data retention for your eval API key. For stricter needs (never leaving your VPC) we'd look at Private - but for many customers using Hosted with retention disabled and token-level redaction, that satisfies the requirement. I'll link security docs but also Marissa can set up the SOC2 evidence bundle if Procurement wants it.

2) Rate limits & burst: default soft rate limits are the ones I sent, but we can provision a temporary elevated burst for the eval. For your 3 TPS peak with parallel tests, I propose: 200 req/min soft limit and 1,200 tokens/sec aggregate for the eval window. That should be sufficient. If you need per-second spikes above that we can add a short-term burst policy.

3) Cost estimate: rough hosted estimate for 2 weeks at ~10k tokens/day (70k total) on our mid-tier model is ~$35- $60 (usage only). If you spin up heavier models for benchmarking it could be higher - we can share a detailed breakout after you pick models.

Proposed next steps: 
- I'll create an eval API key scoped to Finexco and a short-lived elevated rate limit for 2 weeks.
- Marissa will send the SOC2 evidence and a one-page security checklist.
- Matt, if you share a quick smoke-test script (cURL or Node), Marissa can help run it with you.

If that sounds good I'll action the key and elevated limits today.

Best,
Aditya

---
Attachment: (linked) https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2-evidence (sent by Marissa)
